environment.build: pnpm build; immutable dist served with read-only local model and fixture routes; HMR disabled

decision.reason: Invocation 8 is materially worse than the canonical strict-parity defect, so no invocation-7, trajectory, runtime-pair, or E2E gate is justified.
decision.runtimeFinding: ORT GPU-buffer tensor capacity was 26214400 bytes for a 16797696-byte logical Q tensor. The public tensor contract supplies dimensions but no byte offset or strides; the generic WGSL kernel therefore cannot establish the linear GPU layout required for a numerically valid custom reduction.
decision.nextCandidate: ORT-compatible tiled/pairwise lowering or a minimal ORT tensor-layout/custom-op extension that exposes a packed Q/K/V view; do not deploy the WGSL online candidate.
